# cmd: sdkit version
# env: BASH_ENV=.probe.sh
exit: 0
== low standard
task=t risk=low profile=standard verifier=verify-command contracts=off (scout/analyst: off) automatic-retries=1
{
  "task": "t",
  "risk": "low",
  "profile": "standard",
  "verifier": "verify-command",
  "contracts": {
    "writing_and_deciding_roles": "off",
    "lookup_roles": "off"
  },
  "automatic_retries": 1,
  "evidence_roles": []
}

== high high-assurance
